_comment: Ultra-38 B2.2 subset scenarios (tests/u38/*.bas): goldens in tests/golden/u38/ are captured on TSB Neo (build/TSBneo.crt); the Ultra-38 flash spike (build/u38_spike.crt) must match them byte for byte (tests/u38_spike.py). Each program sets TSB Neo's colours and character set first, so the different start-up screens do not matter. The flash spike has no hot-helper copies yet (B3.1), so LINE is slower than on Neo: the picture step waits 200 stable frames.
